description: Run a read-only git command on a project's ShadowGit history: automatic snapshots taken every few minutes, kept apart from the project's own .git. Use it for what changed recently, a file's history, when something broke, or a diff between two points in time. Allowed: log, show, diff, status, blame, shortlog, rev-list, rev-parse, ls-files, ls-tree, cat-file, describe, show-branch. Commands that write, and options that read or write files outside the history (such as --output and --no-index), are refused. Output is capped at 25,000 characters; narrow it with -n, --since, --stat or a path.

command.description: A git command without the leading "git", e.g. log --since="1 hour ago" --stat

repo.description: Project name or absolute path. Defaults to the current project.

description: Pause ShadowGit's automatic snapshots for a project while you make a set of related edits, so they can be saved as one checkpoint instead of several partial snapshots. Returns the existing session if one is already active. Needs the ShadowGit app running. To save the edits and resume snapshots, use checkpoint and end_session.

repo.description: Project name or absolute path. Defaults to the current project.

description: Save the project's current changes to ShadowGit history as one named checkpoint, applying the project's .shadowgit-ignore rules. Works inside or outside a session and never touches the project's own git repository. Returns the commit hash. Needs the ShadowGit app running.

repo.description: Project name or absolute path. Defaults to the current project.

title.description: One line saying what changed, e.g. "Fix login redirect loop"

description: Resume automatic snapshots for a project by ending its active ShadowGit session. Without session_id it ends whatever session is active on the project, and succeeds with nothing to do if there is none. Changes not saved with checkpoint are picked up by the next automatic snapshot.

description: Read ShadowGit's Lens of a range of snapshots, by default the latest AI session's: its steps with their code, the cards (components) and flows on its canvas, each with an id and its words so far. Read it at the end of a session, after the checkpoint, to word it with write_lens_words. Needs the ShadowGit app running.

base.description: The snapshot the range starts from, with head (null: the start of the history). Leave both out for the latest AI session

head.description: The range's newest snapshot; leave out for the latest AI session

repo.description: Project name or absolute path. Defaults to the current project.

name: get_lens
title: Read a range's Lens

description: Write the words the user reads in ShadowGit's Lens for a range get_lens read: a summary, each step's title and body, with a why and an excerpt, each card's role, by the ids get_lens gave. An older ShadowGit takes plain text alone; text past its limit is cut; unknown ids are left out. The app keeps the words in its history: a card's role shows in any later range while its code is unchanged.

base.description: The base get_lens answered (null: from the start of the history)

components.description: Per changed card: the role it plays, in a few words

flows.description: Per flow: a verb phrase, e.g. "draws a range"

layers.description: Per layer: a short name, where the default does not say where code runs

repo.description: Project name or absolute path. Defaults to the current project.

steps.description: Per step: a title naming what it does, and its words; a step's entry replaces everything written for that step before, so send its title, body, why and excerpt together

body.description: One or two sentences: plain text, or pieces, where a piece with a card links that card of the step by its id, only where the text names it

excerpt.description: At most 12 lines that changed, of one of the step's symbols as get_lens lists them: its path on that side, its name, the side and the lines

why.description: Why, in the author's own words: one of get_lens's quotes, or part of one, word for word, within the why limit (a longer quote is left out, not cut); left out where none says why

summary.description: What the change does and why, in two sentences

name: write_lens_words
title: Write a range's Lens words
